name: print-social-cake-brand-project-slide-with-feed-grid-and-script-sticker
title: Cream project slide for a cake-shop Instagram with a 3x3 feed grid and a 'project 2' script sticker
whatItIs: A cream slide with small header labels, a huge chocolate heavy 'cake shop', sparkle doodles, About and Result paragraphs with bold lead-ins and a boxed 3x3 grid of cobalt cake posts, with a big outlined script 'project 2' at the corner.
whatItMeans: Warm and organised; the cobalt feed pops against cream and brown.
techniques: Show the whole feed grid as an image.
Overlap a script sticker on its corner.

vocabulary.definition: An image of a 3x3 profile grid.
